notes: Both faces of West 8th are drawn on this sheet (centre from faces y~298/507). Barr, Kenyon and Wingate Alley all jog north at Cutter: east of Cutter (sheet 41 area, confirmed on sheet 41) Barr is 40 ft centred y~2105 (faces 2038/2173), Kenyon centred y~2804 (faces 2717/2892), Wingate Alley centred y~3276 at Cutter (faces 3237/3305); each is recorded as a separate T on Cutter's east side, the west branches as T on the west side. Linn is 50 ft north of Kenyon (centre x~806) and continues south only as the 20 ft street (faces 827/898, centre 863), recorded as two T points at Kenyon (same as sheet 39). Wingate Alley: the straight branch runs Jane to Cutter (10 ft from Jane to Stone Alley, 20 ft east of Stone Alley); the diagonal branch (printed WINGATE ALLEY, 20') comes from sheet 39 across Jane and ends at Lynch Alley, where Lynch (12 ft, Wingate to the diagonal) turns it into an L junction (recorded as T; beyond it only a 'PASS 2nd' passage under a building). Stone Alley (10 ft) runs Kenyon to Wingate. Jane (36 ft north of Hathaway, 30 ft south; centre x~1489 north, ~1502 south) runs Kenyon to West 6th. Hathaway enters from the sheet 39 side and ends at Jane. West 6th is diagonal (slope ~-0.29) with both faces drawn; Cutter and Jane both end at it (south face continuous). The area west of Jane and south of Kenyon is sheet 39 coverage drawn in outline only. NAMING: both Wingate branches are printed WINGATE ALLEY. The diagonal one (continuous with sheets 38-39, Baymiller to Jane to Lynch) keeps the plain name 'Wingate Alley'; the straight one Jane to Cutter (10' west of Stone Alley, 20' east of it) is 'Wingate Alley (Jane to Cutter)'; the piece east of Cutter is 'Wingate Alley (east of Cutter)'. Likewise 'Barr Street (east of Cutter)' and 'Kenyon Avenue (east of Cutter)' are the jogged pieces from Cutter to Mound (sheets 40-42); the west pieces keep the plain names.
